lines.text: Two thousand seven. An AS/400, millions moving overnight, and books that had to balance by morning.
Lesson one: trust is earned in production.

Then fourteen years of shipping things that had to work. Automation from inside finance. Fifty-plus RPA automations. AIOps across forty thousand devices. Grading Microsoft's Copilot for Entra before the world used it.
Then the industry turned. Enterprises stopped asking whether AI works, and started asking who can make it work.
Today I lead an AI and automation practice: the AI side of the bid, a hundred and fifty use cases shaped into twenty agent families, and a team building on one governed framework.
Every agent runs on a layered architecture, with a control plane across all of it. Read-only, or human-approved. Every time.
From slideware to shipped. I'm Karthikeyan Selvam.
